hook: Meta's AI chief posted an *AI-made video* of Sam Altman dressed as Meta's mascot
caption:
Alexandr Wang, who runs AI at Meta, posted this AI-generated video on Instagram to promote Muse, Meta's AI assistant.
It shows a video call with Wang, Mark Zuckerberg and Muse's mascot Jolly. Then Sam Altman joins, in a furry hooded suit and face paint that make him look like Jolly.
Meta says the post carries its AI label and that Altman has made his likeness available for AI videos. OpenAI did not comment.

Funny marketing, or a line crossed?
